header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Exercise Patience on the Occasions of Death

Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) then said, "Your son has left this world." "Where is he now?" Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) asked. When she informed him that the child was in the inner room, Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) went there, opened the face and recited:
"إِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ"
"To Allaah we belong and to Him shall we return"
He then went to inform Rasulullaah ﷺ about the statement of Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA), to which Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "I swear by the Being Who has sent me with the truth that because of her patience at the demise of her child, Allaah has already placed another son in her womb."
After Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) had delivered the child, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "O Anas! Go and tell your mother that after cutting the umbilical cord, she should not feed anything to the baby without first sending for me." Hadhrat Anas (RA) says, "She then gave the baby in my arms and I took it to Rasulullaah ﷺ. When I placed the baby before Rasulullaah ﷺ, he asked for three Ajwa dates. When I brought them, he removed the stones, chewed on them and then opened the child's mouth to place it inside. The child immediately started turning it about in his mouth, to which Rasulullaah ﷺ remarked, 'The Ansaar certainly love dates.' Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to me, 'Go and tell your mother, 'May Allaah bless you in this child and make him obedient and pious.'"[^1]

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA)'s son was ill and passed away one day when he was out. When he returned, Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) asked, "How is my son?" Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) replied, "He is calmer than he had been." She then served him supper and after he had completed, the couple engaged in sexual relations. It was only afterwards that she told him to bury the child. The next morning when Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) informed Rasulullaah ﷺ about what had happened, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked, "Did you have relations with your wife last night?" After receiving a positive reply, Rasulullaah ﷺ prayed, "O Allaah! Bless them." Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) then gave birth to a son.
Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) then instructed Hadhrat Anas (RA) to carefully take this child to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Ummu Sulaym (RA) also sent some dates with the baby and when Rasulullaah ﷺ took the child, he asked, "Has something come with him?" When the Sahabah (RA) informed him that some dates had also come, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked for them. After chewing them, Rasulullaah ﷺ took it from his mouth, placed it in the child's mouth and rubbed it on the child's palate (called Tahneek). Rasulullaah ﷺ then named the child

Bazzaar. Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.291) has commented on the chain of narrators. Another narration of Bazzaar states that Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) said to Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA), "How can I marry you when you worship the wood which that slave of mine brings?" Ibn Sa'd (Vol.8 Pg.316) has reported a similar narration.
